heroSub: 5 hand-picked hotels near U-Tapao Airport (UTP) around Phlu Ta Luang, Sattahip and Ban Chang that we've reviewed in depth — a budget guesthouse a 10-minute drive from the gate, a quiet residence for travelers with early flights, a shady garden resort, and a resort by a fishing pond. Ideal for pre- or post-flight stays on an affordable budget, with rates from about ฿700–1,200/night.
introH2: ✈️ What kinds of stays are near U-Tapao Airport, and how do you pick the right one?
introHtml: U-Tapao International Airport (UTP) sits in the Sattahip–Ban Chang area, on the border between Chonburi and Rayong, and the stays around it don't all look the same — some are budget guesthouses around Phlu Ta Luang that you can drive to the gate from in ten minutes, ideal for late-night or pre-dawn flights; some are quiet residences with a 24-hour front desk for late arrivals and early-morning departures; and some are garden resorts or fishing-pond resorts that sell calm and low prices. Plenty of travelers book a stay in Pattaya, then have to wake before dawn for a long 30–40-minute drive to the airport to make their flight, leaving them tired before the trip even starts. This article gathers 5 hotels near U-Tapao Airport that we've already reviewed in depth — across Phlu Ta Luang, Sattahip and Ban Chang. Every one comes from reading real guest reviews, telling you both the upsides and the honest caveats, compared across 3 sites with direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: U-Tapao Airport has no rail link, and areas around it like Phlu Ta Luang, Sattahip and Ban Chang have far less public transport than central Pattaya. That makes nearly every stay in this article most convenient with your own car or a rental. If you don't have a car, ask about and book the property's airport transfer in advance, or keep the Grab app ready but allow extra time. The areas covered here: Phlu Ta Luang, Sattahip — closest to the airport, many a 10-minute drive from the gate, quiet, with free parking. Phla–Ban Chang — a quiet garden and seaside zone near Phla Beach and the golf courses, about 14 km from the airport. Samnak Thon, Ban Chang — a fishing-pond resort, about 8–10 km from the airport, a 10–15-minute drive. Central Pattaya is about a 30–40-minute drive from all of them.

entries.type: Budget Guesthouse 2-Star · Closest to the Gate
entries.name: Green Apple Villa
entries.badge: 🍏 Closest to the airport · best value in the group
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phlu Ta Luang·Sattahip · ~3 km from U-Tapao, 10-min drive
entries.addr: 21/21 Moo 2, Phlu Ta Luang Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi Province
entries.storyHtml: If you measure it by "closest to the gate in the group and the best value per baht," plenty of voices in the reviews give it to this one — Green Apple Villa is a budget 2-star guesthouse of over 35 rooms in the Phlu Ta Luang area of Sattahip District, just about 3 kilometers from U-Tapao Airport (UTP), or roughly a 10-minute drive, and about 1.5 kilometers from Phlu Ta Luang train station. It has to be said clearly up front that despite the word "villa" in the name, this is not a pool villa and there is no swimming pool. It's a simple lodging building that sells location and price above all. What guests are impressed by is the room rate including breakfast, which you rarely find at a property in this class — reviews mention dishes like hot crab fried rice, bread and coffee to fill up on before setting off. Add to that the spacious free parking, a 24-hour reception, an airport transfer service, and staff that many reviews describe as friendly and flexible about late check-in and check-out, so travelers on late-night or pre-dawn flights feel at ease. The honest take from real reviews praises the cleanliness, the value, and the convenience near the airport and train station. Honest caveats: some bedding looks worn and is fairly thin, the bathroom floor is slippery with no separation between wet and dry zones so take care, the building feels more like a dormitory than a resort, the area is fairly quiet with few shops around, and it's most convenient with your own car. This isn't a seaside stay you come to for the atmosphere, but a clean, affordable place to sleep that does the job of a "pre- or post-flight stay" well — and the best value for money in this set.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're on a late-night or pre-dawn flight and aren't driving yourself, give your time and ask about the U-Tapao airport transfer service in advance. And don't forget to use the breakfast included in the rate (served around 7:00–10:00) to fuel up before heading to the airport or carrying on with your trip.

Room rate includes breakfast, free wide parking, free Wi-Fi — good value in the budget group

entries.type: Budget Residence · Quiet Residence · 24-Hour Front Desk
entries.name: J L Residence Hotel
entries.badge: 🕒 24-hour front desk · ideal for pre-dawn flights
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phlu Ta Luang·Sattahip · 3–7 km from U-Tapao, 5–10-min drive
entries.addr: 11/193 Moo 2, Phlu Ta Luang Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi Province
entries.storyHtml: If you have a pre-dawn flight at U-Tapao, or you've just landed late at night and don't want the long drive into Pattaya, J L Residence Hotel is the stay that fits exactly that need. It's a small budget residence of about 24 rooms in Phlu Ta Luang Subdistrict, Sattahip District, just about 3–7 kilometers from U-Tapao International Airport (UTP), a 5–10-minute drive, with an airport transfer service (for a fee). It isn't a hotel selling luxury, but it clearly sells two things: a hard-to-find location near the airport, and prices that start in the low four figures. What makes it work for travelers with off-hour flights is the 24-hour front desk — whether you check in late or leave before dawn, someone is there to help. Most of the honest take from real reviews says the rooms are clean, the beds comfortable, the atmosphere quiet and suburban, and the free private parking easy to use. There's also a fitness center, a shared lounge, a terrace, garden-view rooms, and an Asian-style breakfast (check whether your rate includes it). Another group it suits well is staff, crew, or people working in the Sattahip–U-Tapao area and the EEC zone. Honest caveats: the location is away from the main tourist spots, you almost need your own car, taxis are hard to flag, the area around the property is quiet at night and finding food is tricky without a car so buy something to bring along, there's no swimming pool, no pets allowed, and room and service standards can vary a little as it's a small property. A score of 7.4 from 219 reviews plus a Travelers' Choice award reflects that picture well — a budget stay with a clear purpose and good value for travelers genuinely flying out of U-Tapao.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Make use of the 24-hour front desk — give your real check-in and check-out times based on your flight in advance. If you don't have a car, book the airport transfer (for a fee) ahead, and if you arrive late, buy some food to bring along, because the area around the property is quiet.

entries.name: La'moon Resort
entries.revCount: Score around 7.4 · still few online reviews (Trip.com/Booking)
entries.badge: ⛳ Near Navy golf course · transit stay
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phlu Ta Luang·Sattahip · ~13 km from U-Tapao, 15–20-min drive
entries.addr: 36/109 Moo 5, Phlu Ta Luang Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi Province
entries.storyHtml: La'moon Resort is a small resort of about 24 rooms in the Phlu Ta Luang area of Sattahip District, which runs into Ban Chang and sits about 13 kilometers from U-Tapao International Airport (UTP), roughly a 15–20-minute drive. Its position is clear: a transit stay and a base for people with business in the Sattahip area, rather than a holiday destination in its own right. Who it suits is travelers landing late at U-Tapao or with an early flight who want a comfortable place to sleep near the airport, golfers playing the Navy Phlu Ta Luang or Chee Chan courses, and people on official business in the Sattahip naval area. The rooms are simple and all air-conditioned, with a fridge, TV, kettle, and a private bathroom with a hot shower, plus free Wi-Fi and free parking, a short drive from Khao Chi Chan and Ramayana Water Park. To be honest, La'moon Resort is a small property with still-limited and scattered online reviews, so we've written this on the basis of what we could actually verify, while clearly flagging what to ask about before booking. The reviews that do exist praise the location near the airport, the free parking, the quiet of the area, and the affordable price. Honest caveats: it's about a 30–40-minute drive from central Pattaya and you'll need your own car, the facilities aren't as complete as a large resort, and details like a swimming pool, spa and breakfast that some platforms list don't always match — call or message the property directly before booking to confirm they're actually open during your visit, and pick free cancellation up front if your plans aren't firm.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Because reviews are still few, call or message the property directly before booking to confirm the swimming pool, spa and breakfast are actually open during your visit — don't go by the platform photos alone. And pick a free-cancellation rate and compare prices across several sites first.

entries.name: The Moonlight Resort
entries.revCount: Score around 7.7 · still not many reviews (Booking/Trip.com)
entries.badge: 🌿 Quiet garden resort · rooms bigger than the price suggests
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phla·Ban Chang · ~14 km from U-Tapao, 16-min drive
entries.addr: 1/24 Phla Subdistrict, Ban Chang District (Chonburi–Rayong border)
entries.storyHtml: If you're looking for a place to stay a night near U-Tapao Airport, before an early flight or after a late landing, without paying a lot and without the bustle of Pattaya, The Moonlight Resort is a small resort in Phla Subdistrict, Ban Chang District, that's likely to match what you're after. It's a shady garden-style stay of just 15 rooms with a quiet atmosphere, about 14 kilometers from U-Tapao International Airport (UTP), roughly a 16-minute drive, and only about a 5-minute drive from Phla Beach. What real reviews mention most often, and agree on, is that the rooms are bigger than expected for the price — many are surprised by how much space they get for what they pay — and a cleanliness that many reviews call spotless. Every room has a private garden-view balcony, air conditioning, a fridge, and cable TV. The real charm here is the flower-garden setting, the shaded seating pavilions, and the private quiet, plus owners and staff that reviews praise as friendly and able to communicate in English, making it suitable for international travelers too. There's free private parking, an EV charging point, a shared kitchen, a barbecue area, and an airport transfer service (for an extra fee of around 300 baht according to reviews). Honest caveats: the location is so quiet there's barely anything to do in the evening, no nightlife or shops within walking distance, no swimming pool or large-resort facilities, you almost need a car, some blankets are fairly thin so if you get cold easily bring a throw of your own, and breakfast details differ across sources so confirm before booking. If you come for the quiet and the low price, these caveats turn into upsides — a small garden resort that many say is better value than the price suggests.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Arrange a car or book the property's airport transfer in advance, because this location almost requires one. Confirm breakfast before booking, as the information differs across sources, and if you get cold easily bring a light throw of your own or ask for an extra blanket.
pros: Rooms bigger than the price suggests and very clean, every room with a private garden-view balcony
Shady, quiet garden setting, ideal for relaxing away from the bustle of Pattaya
Near U-Tapao Airport and Phla Beach · owner friendly and speaks English
Free private parking, an EV charging point and a shared kitchen/barbecue area
cons: Very quiet location, no nightlife or shops within walking distance
No swimming pool, and you almost need a car, hard to get around on foot
Blankets are fairly thin · breakfast info doesn't match, confirm beforehand (from reviews)

entries.type: Fishing Resort 3-Star · By a Fishing Pond
entries.name: Khwanruen Fishing Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Samnak Thon·Ban Chang · ~8–10 km from U-Tapao, 10–15-min drive
entries.addr: 87/1 Moo 4, Samnak Thon Subdistrict, Ban Chang District, Rayong Province
entries.storyHtml: Closing the set of 5 stays with the option that starts at the lowest price and has the most on-site facilities — Khwanruen Fishing Resort is a small 3-star resort by a fishing pond in Samnak Thon Subdistrict, Ban Chang District, Rayong Province, in the tourist zone on the South Pattaya–U-Tapao border. Administratively it's on the Rayong side, but many platforms group it with stays on the Pattaya/Chonburi side, because it's just about 8–10 kilometers from U-Tapao International Airport (UTP), or roughly a 10–15-minute drive. The selling point, as the name says, is the on-site fishing pond where guests can drop a line, ideal for fishing lovers and families who want the kids to have an outdoor activity, plus an outdoor swimming pool, a waterside restaurant, a barbecue area, and a karaoke room. The honest take from real reviews agrees that the rooms are bigger than expected for the price, the air conditioning is icy cold, the cleanliness is good, the water pressure is good, the atmosphere is quiet, and the staff are easygoing and look after you warmly in a family-resort way, with an average score of around 8.1 from about 136 reviews. The honest caveat mentioned most often is that the entrance signage is unclear — finding the way in the first time can be confusing, especially at night, so prepare your GPS coordinates well. Next is that the air conditioning in some rooms is uneven or noisy, some rooms are starting to show their age, some dishes are strongly flavored/salty for some people, and there's no public transport right there, so it suits people with their own car best. If you fly in and out of U-Tapao often, or want a quiet base to relax before heading to Pattaya–Rayong, this fits that need well at a price that's hard to match.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Prepare your GPS coordinates and check the map well before you set off, because the entrance signage is unclear and it's hard to find the first time, especially at night. If room condition matters to you, ask for a recently renovated room or one by the pond/garden, and when ordering food you can specify how salty or spicy you'd like it.

faqTitle: FAQ — Questions Travelers Often Ask About Stays Near U-Tapao Airport

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best hotel near U-Tapao Airport?
faq.a: It depends on your travel style. If you measure it by closeness to the airport and value, Green Apple Villa is just ~3 km away, a 10-min drive, with breakfast included, score 8.1. If you have a pre-dawn flight or a late arrival and need a front desk all night, J L Residence Hotel has a 24-hour front desk. If you're coming for a round of golf in the Sattahip area, La'moon Resort. If you want quiet and roomy spaces, The Moonlight Resort. And if you want the lowest starting price with a fishing pond and pool, Khwanruen Fishing Resort ฿700.

faq.q: ❓ How much does a stay near U-Tapao Airport cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at about ฿700–1,200 per night. The lowest starting prices are Khwanruen Fishing Resort at ฿700 and Green Apple Villa at ฿890. The mid group is J L Residence at ฿900 and The Moonlight Resort at ฿1,000. The highest in the set is La'moon Resort starting at ฿1,200. All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms; during long holidays they may be higher than usual and rooms fill quickly.

faq.q: ❓ Do you need your own car to stay near U-Tapao Airport?
faq.a: Not for every property, but having your own car or a rental is most convenient, because the Sattahip–Ban Chang area has far less public transport than central Pattaya. Every stay has free parking. If you don't have a car, Green Apple Villa and J L Residence are near the airport and have transfers, while Ban Chang-zone stays like The Moonlight and Khwanruen almost require a car, so book the property's airport transfer in advance.

faq.q: ❓ Which stay is best for a pre-dawn flight or a late landing?
faq.a: The standout here is J L Residence Hotel, with a 24-hour front desk that handles late check-in and pre-dawn check-out, plus an airport transfer. Next is Green Apple Villa, with a 24-hour reception and the closest position to the gate at ~3 km. Both are in the Phlu Ta Luang area, a few minutes' drive to the airport, ideal for travelers who don't want to wake before dawn for the long drive from Pattaya.

faq.q: ❓ Do stays near U-Tapao Airport have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Some do. Khwanruen Fishing Resort has an outdoor swimming pool and an on-site fishing pond. Green Apple Villa and J L Residence have no swimming pool, as they're a small guesthouse and residence focused on location and price. The Moonlight Resort also has no pool but sells a quiet garden atmosphere. As for La'moon Resort, some platforms list a pool but the information doesn't match across all channels, so confirm with the property before booking.

faq.q: ❓ How far in advance should you book a stay near U-Tapao Airport?
faq.a: Most of the stays in this article are small (15–54 rooms, some just 15), so they fill quickly. For weekends, long holidays, and times with events in the Sattahip–U-Tapao area, book 2–4 weeks ahead or more. In normal periods 1–2 weeks ahead is enough. We recommend picking Free Cancellation up front if your flight isn't firm, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price.
